strings.zh: 喝了月见山的泉水之后{NEWLINE}能够强身健体,{CLEAR}我也经常喝哦！
strings.en: Drinking Mt. Moon spring water keeps{NEWLINE}you strong and healthy. I drink it all{CLEAR}the time!

strings.zh: 登山累了吧？{NEWLINE}好好休息一下吧。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Tired from the climb?{NEWLINE}Take a good rest.{VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0048/1; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 你好啊年轻人,{NEWLINE}欢迎光临本店。
strings.en: Hello there, young one. Welcome to my{NEWLINE}shop.
{VAR:0103:0}: Hello. I’d like to see what you{NEWLINE}have for sale.

strings.zh: 真是抱歉啊年轻人,{NEWLINE}本店现在没有商品出售。
strings.en: I’m terribly sorry, young one, but we{NEWLINE}don’t have anything for sale right now.

strings.zh: 本店原本出售的是{NEWLINE}便于在旅途中携带和饮用的{CLEAR}瓶装的月见山泉水。{SCROLL}但是最近来了一个叫麻生的年轻人,{NEWLINE}表面上一副彬彬有礼的样子,{CLEAR}却霸占了泉水不让别人使用。{SCROLL}所以因为采集不到原材料,{NEWLINE}瓶装月见山泉水也就没货了。
strings.en: We used to sell bottles of Fresh Water{NEWLINE}from Mt. Moon’s spring. They’re easy to{CLEAR}carry and drink on the road.{SCROLL}But recently a young man called Asher{NEWLINE}showed up. He seems perfectly polite on{CLEAR}the surface...{SCROLL}...but he’s taken over the spring and{NEWLINE}won’t let anyone else use it.{SCROLL}With no way to collect the water, we’ve{NEWLINE}run out of Fresh Water.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position | 月见山泉水 is the item Fresh Water (item 30).

strings.zh: 我听说是你赶走了麻生呢。{NEWLINE}多亏你的努力,{CLEAR}我现在又可以取到泉水了。{CLEAR}这瓶泉水送给你,算是我的感谢。
strings.en: I heard you’re the one who drove Asher{NEWLINE}away. Thanks to you, I can collect{CLEAR}spring water again.{SCROLL}Please take this bottle of spring water{NEWLINE}as thanks.

strings.zh: 本店特产：瓶装月见山泉水。{NEWLINE}非常便于在旅途中携带和饮用。{CLEAR}600元一瓶,要来一瓶吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Our specialty: Fresh Water, bottled{NEWLINE}from Mt. Moon’s spring! It’s easy to{CLEAR}carry and drink on the road.{SCROLL}It’s $600 a bottle. Would you like one?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 本店的瓶装月见山泉水,{NEWLINE}使用了除菌工艺,保质期超久。{CLEAR}请拿好。
strings.en: Our bottled Fresh Water is sterilized,{NEWLINE}so it keeps for a very long time. Here{CLEAR}you go.

strings.zh: 你带的钱似乎不太够啊……
strings.en: You don’t seem to have quite enough{NEWLINE}money...
